flow: Native Windows UI Automation for the Note to inspect menu button

initial_tree.name: Native Rust migration is in progress.
Create note from Canvas text card
Resolve wiki links, Markdown links and embeds against a stable vault snapshot. This check does not change vault files.
History is stored in private application data outside the vault.
Refresh the preview to apply the selected retention settings to the listing.
Read-only projections over Markdown frontmatter. Evaluation does not write to the vault.
Use Refresh Bases files to read a bounded, stable vault snapshot.
Read-only projections from embedded Base fences in Markdown notes. Evaluation is bounded and tied to the selected note revision and vault snapshot.
BitLocker reports the system drive unprotected or fully decrypted.
This check covers only the reported system volume or root filesystem.
Preview optional app-data cleanup choices for the operating-system uninstaller. Package integration is pending; changing these choices here does not delete data. Vaults are never cleanup targets.
Derived indexes, UI state and disposable runtime cache.
Provider credentials kept in OS-backed credential storage.
Managed recovery snapshots; unresolved conflicts remain protected.
No local cleanup selected; the vault remains preserved.
Full-featured Markdown editing and plugin compatibility are not available in this preview.
